findings.message: The param listaId selects formularioLista but no request fetches one record. Added public selectLista(id | null) and the getter formularioLista (row of the loaded listas by selectedLista); selecting also fills salvarListaDraft from the row; an unknown id publishes client.selectionInvalid in listarListasError.
buscarListas takes a name fragment but no state holds it. Added the public state busca (written by buscarListas(busca)); no separate setter is needed.
The commands criarLista and salvarLista have no <command>.input state. Added criarListaDraft and salvarListaDraft (the latter carries id and version) with setCriarListaDraft and setSalvarListaDraft.

After criarLista or salvarLista the returned list is upserted by id (a new one is appended at the end) into listas. The browser does not sort by nome nor re-apply the active busca filter, so the order or the filter may differ from the backend until listarListas or buscarListas is called again.
public busca is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
